description.value: Clinical assessment of an individual's propensity to experience a harmful or adverse physiological reaction upon exposure, or repeated exposure, to a substance. Substances include, among others, a therapeutic substance administered correctly and in the appropriate dosage for the individual (side effects); food; material derived from plants or animals; or venom from insect bites.

purpose.value: This profile is the FHIR implementation of the general building block [AllergyIntolerance](https://decor.nictiz.nl/ad/#/gbb2026bbr-/datasets/dataset/2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.3.11.60.153.1.8).
